Final Project.title: Air Quality Monitoring System (IoT & Machine Learning)
Final Project.description: Modular backend for real-time air quality forecasting. Integrates a Laravel backend with a Flask machine learning microservice predicting AQI via the Prophet model. Formulated a 4-layer architecture (Device, Service, Data, Presentation) validated under load.
Final Project.myRole: Backend Developer — Laravel REST APIs, PostgreSQL, system validation
outcome: Published as a peer-reviewed conference paper at IEEE ICoDSA 2025
API performance measured at 557 ms average response time (paper)
4-layer architecture validated under load and stress testing
advisor: Dr. Hanif Fakhrurroja, S.Si, M. T.

Group.title: AI & ML based Health Diagnosis System
Group.description: Team of 6 building an AI/ML health diagnosis system predicting Alzheimer's, pneumonia, and fetal health. I worked as the business analyst: gathering requirements, mapping the diagnosis flow, and bridging the ML team's model outputs with user-facing screening needs.
Group.myRole: Business Analyst — requirements, diagnosis flow, team of 6 (AI/ML)
outcome: Requirements and diagnosis flow for multi-disease screening
Mitigated user trust issues in diagnostic screening flows
